name: ClawdBrowser Tools
description: Official plugin: expose ClawdBrowser SOL GPT tools.md catalog to elizaOS agents — search, describe, list 171 non-custodial Solana research + user-signed prepare tools.

CLAWDBROWSER_TOOLS_MD.label: tools.md path
CLAWDBROWSER_TOOLS_MD.help: Absolute path to ClawdBrowser tools.md (default: ~/ClawdBrowser/tools.md or /Users/8bit/ClawdBrowser/tools.md)

CLAWDBROWSER_ROOT.label: ClawdBrowser root
CLAWDBROWSER_ROOT.help: ClawdBrowser checkout root; tools.md is resolved as <root>/tools.md

CLAWDBROWSER_API_URL.label: API base URL
CLAWDBROWSER_API_URL.help: Optional ClawdBrowser / sol-gpt API base for future live tool relay

CLAWDBROWSER_ENABLED.label: Enabled
CLAWDBROWSER_ENABLED.help: Set false to disable catalog loading
